objective.objective_text: Run the bounded CS1-CS4 continuous-session development rehearsal on the prepared isolated Minecraft course as DatDamPig. Use only the approved Walk, Look, Jump and Fluid TAS sequence capabilities. First inspect fresh footing, hazards and a bounded useful route; preserve player viability. Prove three linked moving successors through the real compiler, broker and resident executor, then interruption, revocation, stale rejection and fresh observation re-entry. Stop on manual input or an unsafe/stale condition. Do not mutate blocks, inventory or other actors, broaden permissions, or claim ET6/NAV1 acceptance.

findings: Original repeat-cache defect repaired: three delayed identical requests returned ready with distinct perception evidence and the same context.
First request refreshed only the stale observation epoch on the existing subject binding; next two returned no repairs.
Goal remained revision 1 with identical event hash and no attempts through all three successful calls.
Existing accepted pairing survived native restart without new human consent; one bounded saved-trust transport transition restored Full Harness.
Only expired source and player credentials were recovered through supported opaque MCP handoffs; authority ID, policy, capability set and deadline stayed unchanged.

New blocker: after player credential recovery changes its action producer epoch, the active goal has no recovery_required event. Native and MCP agree on goal/perception blocking; MCP reports durable_goal_authority_stale.
